conclusions.statement: Document A (conmed-doc-a) is the BASE, currently-operative credit agreement: the Eighth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, dated June 10, 2025, among CONMED Corporation (Parent Borrower), Foreign Subsidiary Borrowers, the Lenders, and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as Administrative Agent.
limitations: Package fact — not a capacity determination

conclusions.statement: Document B (conmed-doc-b) is a full, freestanding GUARANTEE-AND-SECURITY document (Amended and Restated Guarantee and Collateral Agreement, dated June 10, 2025) that itself amends and restates a prior Guarantee and Collateral Agreement originally dated August 28, 2002 (amended 2003, 2006, 2013, 2016, and a Fifth Amendment dated July 16, 2021 - none of which are part of this package). Document B explicitly relates to Document A by name and exact execution date in its own recitals ("the Eighth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, dated as of June 10, 2025").
limitations: Package fact — not a capacity determination

conclusions.statement: Document C (conmed-doc-c) is the Second Amendment, dated August 1, 2022, to the SEVENTH Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, dated July 16, 2021 - a document that is NOT part of this package (the package deliberately omits it). Document C therefore amends a PRIOR, now-superseded base agreement, not Document A. This relationship is intentionally unresolvable from within this package alone (analogous to the LSB fixture's own Joinder-to-absent-Intercreditor-Agreement design) and any resolver that links Document C to Document A as if they were the same agreement is wrong.
evidenceCitations: conmed-doc-c-second-amendment-2022 preamble: "SECOND AMENDMENT, dated as of August 1, 2022... to the Seventh Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, dated as of July 16, 2021"
limitations: Package fact — not a capacity determination

conclusions.statement: Document D (conmed-doc-d) is the First Omnibus Amendment and Increased Facility Activation Notice, dated May 27, 2026, and amends BOTH Document A ("the Eighth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, dated as of June 10, 2025") AND Document B ("the Amended and Restated Guarantee and Collateral Agreement, dated as of the June 10, 2025") simultaneously - a genuine two-target amendment relationship, both targets present and identifiable in this package.
evidenceCitations: conmed-doc-d-first-omnibus-amendment-2026 preamble: "to (a) the Eighth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement... and (b) the Amended and Restated Guarantee and Collateral Agreement..."
limitations: Package fact — not a capacity determination

conclusions.statement: Document D adds a new $450,000,000 Term A-2 incremental term loan facility via an Increased Facility Activation Notice mechanism under Section 2.28 of Document A, and is signed by Linvatec Nederland B.V. as a Foreign Subsidiary Borrower.
limitations: Package fact — not a capacity determination

conclusions.statement: Linvatec Nederland B.V. was ALREADY a Foreign Subsidiary Borrower as of Document C (August 2022) - it is not a brand-new entity being joined to the credit group for the first time in Document D (2026). Document D's real function for Linvatec Nederland B.V. is activating its participation in the NEW Term A-2 tranche, not a first-time joinder. (Self-correction: this package's own README speculatively described Document D as "joinder-like new-party-activation content" before this fact was confirmed by reading Document C in full during ground-truth authoring - the correction is recorded here, not silently made.)
evidenceCitations: conmed-doc-c-second-amendment-2022 signature block: "LINVATEC NEDERLAND B.V., as a Foreign Subsidiary Borrower"
limitations: Package fact — not a capacity determination

conclusions.statement: Document D's Section 4 (Reaffirmation) has each Loan Party reaffirm its guarantee and security obligations under Document B (the Guarantee and Collateral Agreement) and confirm the continued perfected priority of all Liens - naming 8 Guarantors by name (Aspen Laboratories, Inc.; SurgiQuest, Inc.; Linvatec Corporation; Viking Systems, Inc.; Buffalo Filter LLC; IN2BONES GLOBAL, INC.; IN2BONES USA, LLC; Bioerz, Inc.) in its signature block.
limitations: Package fact — not a capacity determination

conclusions.statement: Document C makes three definitional amendments to Document A's precursor (the Seventh A&R) AND one direct amendment-and-restatement of the maintenance financial covenant at Section 7.1(b), replacing a flat 5.50x Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio cap with a stepped schedule ranging from 5.25x to 6.25x across specific 2021-2023 fiscal quarter ends. This is real, material, quantitative financial-covenant content - even though it targets a document (the Seventh A&R) that is not itself in this package, the NATURE of the amendment (a covenant-ratio step schedule) is exactly the kind of content Phase 2F's package-graph and discovery layers should recognize as material, regardless of whether the ultimate target document is in-package.
limitations: Package fact — not a capacity determination

conclusions.statement: 7.1 FINANCIAL_COVENANTS: Four maintenance financial covenants: (a) Consolidated Senior Secured Leverage Ratio <= 3.75x (with a 0.50x Material-Acquisition step-up, max twice, 2-quarter gap); (b) Consolidated Total Leverage Ratio <= 5.50x (same step-up mechanic, capped at 6.00x); (c) Minimum Interest Coverage Ratio >= 2.75x; (d) a springing Liquidity covenant ($75M + Early Maturing Debt) that activates only within 91 days of Convertible Notes maturity and only if Early Maturing Debt exceeds $200M.
